brief.title: Compare the grant period's results with the original targets
brief.plain_summary: Total each measure over the grant period with the read-only tool, compare it with the original target, and copy spending by budget line from the finance lead's figures, keeping every missing number unknown.
brief.outcome: A period results table with percent of target and spending by line, every missing number kept null.
